Description Fully renovated in recent years and finished to an exceptional standard, this home combines contemporary style with generous family living in a cul de sac. A spacious entrance hall leads to a bright front sitting room, where large windows with shutters create a calm and sophisticated atmosphere with excellent natural light. To the rear, an impressive open plan kitchen, dining and family room stretches across the full width of the house. The shaker style kitchen includes a central island, extensive storage and integrated appliances, while full width bi-folding doors open onto the terrace and garden to create a seamless flow between inside and outside. Much of the ground floor benefits from underfloor heating. The ground floor also includes a formal dining room, a utility room and a generous bedroom with an ensuite shower room, offering flexibility for guests, working from home, or multigenerational living. Upstairs, five well proportioned bedrooms include a principal suite with a large bedroom, a bespoke fitted dressing room, and a luxurious ensuite bathroom. Two beautifully finished family bathrooms, one with a freestanding bath and one with a walk in shower, serve the remaining bedrooms. A wide landing with remote controlled Velux windows brings natural light into the centre of the home. Additional features include a security and intercom system, together with a comprehensive Home AV system managed through Control 4 for seamless smart living. The front of the property offers a generous gravel driveway framed by mature planting, while the rear garden has been designed for low maintenance with a raised dining terrace, well screened seating areas, and a detached summer house suitable as a studio, gym or home office. This is a stylish and meticulously finished home in one of Weybridge’s most desirable residential locations, offering spacious accommodation, a private garden, and exceptional standard of modern living. Location Weybridge is situated in Surrey, on the south bank of the River Thames, at the mouth of the River Wey. It is an attractive commuter town offering a full range of properties from one bedroom flats, through Victorian villas to large mansion houses in private gated estates. Weybridge includes St George's Hill, an area of 900 acres which includes a championship golf course and private lawn tennis club, surrounded by some of the most exclusive houses in the UK. Weybridge town centre has a range of both high street chains and individual boutiques, including a Waitrose supermarket, plus a good mix of bars and restaurants. Transport links are excellent in this area. Weybridge mainline station has a regular service to London Waterloo in 28 minutes and the M25 (Junc. 10) is 3 miles away giving access to the motorway network. Central London is 21 miles and accessed via the A3 (2.5 miles) and Heathrow airport (13 miles) and Gatwick airport (21 miles) are in easy reach. Please note all distances are approximate. Square Footage: 2,600 sq ft Additional Info Holding Deposit : £1,603.85 (1 week) Deposit Payable : £9,623.08 (6 weeks) Minimum Term if Non-Housing Act Tenancy: 12 months Rent must be paid monthly in advance.
